bounded_precheck_contract.runtime: One fresh owned no-window x86/WOW64 fixture under its own debug parent; no extra debugger attaches to parent, no parent DR writes. <=20 seconds externally enforced.
bounded_precheck_contract.construction: Fixture registers an independent VEH before creating/entering the wait path, preallocates and touches shared records, and calls the real unchanged NtWaitForSingleObject with non-alertable wait. First consumer instruction is a fixed authenticated fixture address.
bounded_precheck_contract.arm: Only when owned worker is demonstrably blocked on its owned unsignaled event, temporarily suspend it and save original raw user-context/DR. Require an actually unused DR slot by enable bits, not just address zero. Reject RF=1/TF=1 or preexisting debug state that invalidates ownership. Arm one execution slot, preserve unrelated slots and all non-debug state, read back, resume.
bounded_precheck_contract.release: Owned peer legitimately signals the owned event. Never write the wait result, consumer state, game fields, code or IAT.
bounded_precheck_contract.parent: Original fixture debug parent records exact code/first-chance/TID/IP and passes its predeclared DBG_EXCEPTION_NOT_HANDLED unchanged. Normal initial debugger breakpoint handled under fixture policy. No second debug layer.
bounded_precheck_contract.VEH_filter: Accept only expected thread, execution IP, owned DR slot/status and compatible single-step code; all unrelated exceptions return CONTINUE_SEARCH. Capture raw EXCEPTION_RECORD and OS-supplied CONTEXT.
bounded_precheck_contract.VEH_gate: Use only preallocated/pretouched shared memory and bounded atomic ACK spin/YieldProcessor. No heap allocation, CRT logging or synchronization-object wait in handler. External parent observes entered=1 and consumer=0 before ACK.
bounded_precheck_contract.restore: Restore original owned DR address/status/control baseline in supplied context, preserving all other context bytes including EIP/EAX/GPR/EFLAGS/RF/x87/XMM. Save before/after context bytes and an explicit allowed-byte delta. Return EXCEPTION_CONTINUE_EXECUTION to original same instruction; do not skip or manufacture return values.

special_APC_prerequisite_research.guest_failure_scope: Prior Server2022 instrumentation-callback refusal/turbo bypass is not generalized to all host builds. Host local bytes/qualification are root-agent work.

primary_references.supports: VEH follows debugger first chance and precedes stack unwind.
NOT_HANDLED first chance dispatches handlers; CONTINUE terminates exception processing.
CONTINUE_EXECUTION resumes exception point; handler should avoid allocation/synchronization-object acquisition.
OS saves thread machine context and exception record for resumable dispatch.
Instruction execution breakpoint is a fault before target instruction; RF suppresses instruction breakpoints. No blanket claim that CPU sets RF on instruction breakpoint.
Guard is one-shot and cleared by OS; system-service guard access can fail service.
Special APC after blocked system service/wait finishes, currently native-only/notWoW; Win32 client minimum22000.
Original author implementation analysis of RS5 NtQueueApcThreadEx special APC interface; not official supported-WOW64 assurance.
Original author native64 ordinary APC example in WOW64 requires alertable wait; no special-APC inference.
